name: TaxiDriver
author: Dominik
description: Taxi service controlled only through the in-game phone. CALL TAXI uses SpikeCommands.CallTaxi -> SpikeRunner.TickAutoRun to spawn a TaxiDriver-owned vehicle at the stand, board the registered taxi_driver, then navigate to the player. The app retains destination selection, search, filters, live ride status, fare display, and STOP. Vanilla E entry/exit and Escape phone-close remain unchanged. TaxiDriver installs no keyboard bindings. The taxi.glb visual is loaded through S1MAPI.Gltf.GltfLoader only when a usable renderer is present; failed imports leave vanilla visuals visible. Destruction is restricted to the exact TaxiDriver-owned vehicle; uncertain destruction retains the tracked state. Passenger rides fail closed unless all required protection patches are installed. Fares are bounded and an uncertain payment result is not retried. Current target: Schedule I 0.4.7f12, local S1API 3.2.1-beta.8, and S1MAPI 2.0.1; build and gameplay evidence are in docs/compatibility.md.
